cat > /home/wlia0047/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/results/research/issue121/rounds/round_20261026_015406_723/agents/pairwise_3_2/pairwise.txt <<'EOF'
WINNER: successor_shell_budget
FIRST LISTED: curved_transition_residual
ARGUMENT: behavior_evidence favors successor_shell_budget: the observed train-only entropy stratification strongly supports behaviorally distinct successor predictability (E5), and its shared branching budget directly uses that signal to structure child partitions; evidence that coarse first-level capacity preserves positives also supports the stated allocation rationale (E8). geometry_necessity favors successor_shell_budget: its curved child assignment is behavior-conditioned and its matched Euclidean control is specified (E12-E15), while curved_transition_residual's transport-and-subtract mechanism is particularly exposed to the existing tangent-successor-residual negative (E6-E7). novelty/exploration_value also modestly favor successor_shell_budget: it proposes a shared subtree branching-budget/partition objective rather than another residual steering variant, although it remains close to prior successor-conditioned mechanisms.
FAILURE RISK: The forced coarse T1 may simply move errors into T2/T3, and successor-conditioned sibling constraints may overfit frequent transitions or worsen reconstruction; the existing successor_geodesic_coarse result is already weak (recall@10 0.055, E6), so the added budget/partition mechanism may fail to improve recommendation over controls.
EOF
